feed.title: EMP Metals Reaches Critical Milestone as Project Aurora Moves Toward Commercial Lithium Production
feed.summary: EMP Metals Corp. has completed construction and is 50% finished with commissioning its Project Aurora lithium brine demonstration plant in Saskatchewan, aiming for a Q3 startup. This milestone transitions the project from infrastructure building to generating critical operational data, which will derisk the commercial scale-up by establishing accurate operating costs, refining capital estimates, and optimizing design. The direct wellhead connection of the plant ensures realistic data collection for a future 6,000 tonnes per year commercial facility, with a potential initial phase at 1,500 tonnes per year, leveraging Saskatchewan's cleaner brine chemistry for more efficient production.

feed.title: Trust is commerce media’s most valuable currency, says Amex SVP Jake King
feed.summary: Jake King, SVP of Amex Offers Digital Media at American Express, asserts that trust, rather than just data, will define the next phase of commerce media, especially with the rise of AI. King believes that companies with established trusted customer relationships will have a competitive advantage over those relying purely on scale and algorithms.

feed.title: Nebraska Regulator Files Complaint Against The Andersons After Unpaid Farmer Claim
feed.summary: A Nebraska regulator has filed a complaint against The Andersons, an Ohio-based agribusiness, for allegedly failing to make timely payments to a grain producer. Although the initial complaint from one producer has been resolved, the Public Service Commission is investigating further and urges other farmers with similar experiences to come forward. The complaint could lead to civil penalties or the revocation of The Andersons' license in Nebraska, highlighting the financial risks producers face with delayed payments.
